title: Using large-scale experiments and machine learning to discover theories of human decision-making
summary: A large risky-choice experiment was analysed with neural-network-implemented interpretable theories, recapitulating historical findings and yielding a new, more accurate model of human decision-making.
ai_technology: Differentiable decision theories implemented as neural networks

source_review.scope: Europe PMC metadata and abstract only; Methods not read.

evidence.tested: Held-out predictive accuracy reported in abstract.
evidence.unknown: Independent replication not assessed; psychology rather than physical-science finding.
evidence.ai_role: Gradient-based optimisation of neural-network theories found a new model.
